firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently petted a cat starts the first round.
houseFallback: If there is a tie or this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: The starting player rolls the dice and chooses the first die. The other players choose clockwise before everyone marks items or passes.
If the game continues, the player to the left of the current starter begins the next round.
